plugin.note: A trivial starter task: Crawling Hands have 15 Hitpoints, max hit 1, and Defence level 3 with no defensive bonuses, so any melee weapon clears them. They are undead, so a salve amulet gives a small damage bonus. No protective item is needed.

requirements: 5 Slayer is required to harm Crawling Hands.
Priest in Peril must be completed to enter the Slayer Tower ground floor.
No combat level requirement and no quest requirement beyond Slayer Tower access.
mechanics: Crawling Hands have 15 Hitpoints and a max hit of 1, making them a very safe low-level task.
They are undead: the salve amulet and Crumble Undead both apply.
They attack with melee (crush) at 4 ticks and have no elemental weakness.
Defence level 3 with all defensive bonuses 0, so weapon choice is unimportant.

methods.label: Any melee weapon
methods.summary: Kill the ground-floor Crawling Hands with any melee weapon; their low Defence makes weapon choice unimportant.
steps: Complete Priest in Peril and travel to the Slayer Tower.
Kill the ground-floor Crawling Hands; max hit 1 means no food or prayer is needed.
Equip a salve amulet for a small undead damage bonus if you have one.
notes: Meiyerditch Laboratories is an alternative spawn for players who have progressed Sins of the Father.

methods.label: Salve amulet melee
methods.summary: Wear a salve amulet (e) for a 20% undead damage-and-accuracy bonus while meleeing.
recommendedFor: players who own a salve amulet
steps: Kill the Crawling Hands; the undead bonus speeds up an already trivial task.
notes: The salve amulet does not stack with the Slayer helmet bonus; the higher of the two applies.
